statement: The complete preregistered dataset-size, mutation-rate, workload-diversity, skew, and recomputation/materialization-policy sweep produces paired SLO capacity, whole-topology resource, infrastructure-cost, uncertainty, and crossover evidence for every cell without presuming a crossover or its sign.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not seal this Quest until benchmark-statistical-capacity-protocol and benchmark-whole-topology-resource-accounting are terminal.
Closure requires valid evidence or explicit non-measuring classification for every preregistered cell and neither presumes a crossover nor requires Lagrange to win.
Apply the harness-fidelity attack checklist and retain immutable raw artifacts plus live engagement evidence for every measured matrix identity.
